en.headline: Very hot weather to continue, extremely hot over weekend
en.dek: The Observatory warns of prolonged high temperatures with parts of the New Territories expected to reach 36 degrees or above under the influence of outer subsiding air from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said very hot weather would persist over the coming days, with conditions becoming extremely hot during the weekend under the influence of outer subsiding air associated with Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.

A special weather tip issued on Thursday afternoon noted that temperatures in parts of the New Territories could reach 36 degrees Celsius or higher over the weekend. The public, especially those engaging in outdoor activities, was advised to pay attention to physical condition and take precautions against heat stroke.

The Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force. Friday is expected to be mainly fine and very hot, with a maximum of around 34 degrees in urban areas. The nine-day forecast indicates mainly fine and extremely hot conditions on Saturday and Sunday, with isolated showers and thunderstorms possible. Members of the public are urged to drink plenty of water and avoid prolonged outdoor exposure during the hottest hours.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣持續 周末部分地區極端酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台指出受熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，未來數日高溫持續，周末新界部分地區氣溫可達36度或以上。
body: 香港天文台表示，未來數日高溫天氣持續，受熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，周末期間天氣極端酷熱，新界部分地區氣溫可達36度或以上。
天文台於周四下午發出特別天氣提示，提醒市民特別是進行戶外活動時留意身體狀況，慎防中暑。酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。
周五大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約34度。九天天氣預報顯示，周六及周日大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，間中有驟雨及雷暴。市民應多補充水分，避免在酷熱時段長時間留在戶外。
